State & Activity Diagrams

Orders, rides, vending machines, elevators and TCP connections all live in "states" and move between them on events. After this page you can draw a state diagram with guards and actions, turn it into code three ways (switch, table, State pattern), make a transition safe when two threads race, and know when an activity diagram is the better picture.
